name: investor-tools
description: Plataforma de Luifer — backend NestJS y frontend Next.js

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors yellow,cyan --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend exec tsc -- --noEmit && npm --prefix frontend exec tsc -- --noEmit
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
